text.text_excerpt: This is another cool brewery that came from a humble homebrewer. Just last year, the owner was in the Nola On Tap homebrewer competition and won first place! Not a easy task! Now he has a real brewery. Dreams do come true! What really impressed me is they opened up with 16 beers ready to go! I mean they came out the corner swinging! I heard they took the time to dial in the brews and even had to dump out entire batches because it wasn't right. They are serious about the quality of the beer. They had pretty much all varieties of beer represented. Even a cider and sours. I think at this point they were more the straight versions. I Loved finally visiting Zony Mash Beer Project! It's a large outside space that is used for multiple purposes. The evening I went there was a vintage clothing pop up, a live band playing music and the burger and beer truck/bus serving up all the delicious items! The burgers are so juicy and really put you in the joy of Spring and Summer time grilling. They have french fries and Brussel spouts as side options. The french fries have a special sauce that you can order for a little extra and it doesn't disappoint. There is tones of seating at the location and you have the option to order you food and grab some of the unique beers to go if you would like! I enjoy sour ale beers and I was shoc...

A fun new brewery in an old theater space. In fact, if you don't know what to look for, it might be very confusing for you or your Lyft driver. Anyway, the place is gigantic, with a ton of open space. Tables, and some school chairs set up for the projector by the front (which was set up for the Saints game). Dog and kid friendly. There's also an upstairs area, which was still under renovation, but seemed super cool for private events in the future and whatnot. They have a great beer selection. I highly suggest going with a flight. I went on a bit of a sour bender, with #1 Jitterbug (sour w/passionfruit, mango and dragonfruit), #5 Quite Fetching (IPA with mango and lactose), #7 Buggin' Out...
